# Macros

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

Records raw terminal output in 64 session-local slots and replays it without interpreting its text or escape sequences.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#terminal-output-macros).

## BeginRecord

```PPL
Macros.BeginRecord(INTEGER slot) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Starts recording raw output for slot 0–63. Text, control characters and ANSI/VT sequences are preserved verbatim; each stream is limited to 512 KiB. No terminal command is emitted until recorded bytes are replayed.

## Delete

```PPL
Macros.Delete(INTEGER slot) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Deletes one session-local recording. No terminal sequence is sent.

## DeleteAll

```PPL
Macros.DeleteAll() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Deletes all session-local recordings. No terminal sequence is sent.

## EndRecord

```PPL
Macros.EndRecord() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Stops the active recording and stores its caller/sysop byte streams. No terminal sequence is sent.

## Play

```PPL
Macros.Play(INTEGER slot) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Writes the recorded bytes directly to the caller/sysop terminal stream. The bytes may contain any ANSI/VT or proprietary sequences originally recorded; no transformation or capability check is performed.

## Recording

`Macros.Recording: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether a terminal macro is currently recording.
